EXHIBIT B — PRICING EXHIBIT

Exhibit B (Pricing Exhibit) to Statement of Work SOW-001 under the Master
Service Agreement between Harborview Health Systems and Trellis Data
Partners, Inc. dated 3 March 2026.

1. IMPLEMENTATION FEE. Fixed fee of USD 410,000 for Phase 1 implementation
across the three (3) pilot facilities, billed: 30% upon contract signature,
40% upon go-live, 30% upon completion of the stabilization period.

2. SUBSCRIPTION FEE. Following go-live, a monthly subscription fee of USD
22,000 per facility applies, billed monthly in arrears.

3. ANNUAL ESCALATION. On each anniversary of the Effective Date of the
Master Service Agreement (3 March), the subscription fee shall increase by
the greater of the applicable Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers
(CPI-U) or three percent (3%) (the "Escalation Floor").

4. PAYMENT TERMS. Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days (net-30).
